meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先在项目的知识图谱中定位你指定的文件、函数或模块节点,再结合它的上下游连接和源码,讲解架构角色、内部结构、外部依赖和数据流。
howto.when: 当你需要深入了解某个文件、函数或模块时会接管;如果项目里还没有知识图谱文件,它会先让你运行 /understand。

say.note: 讲解该文件的架构位置与数据流

say.text: 深入讲讲 src/auth/login.ts:verifyToken 这个函数
say.note: 结合它的上下游连接和源码讲解

howto.what_en: After install, Claude locates the node for the file, function, or module you name in the project's knowledge graph, then reads its edges and source to explain its architectural role, internal structure, dependencies, and data flow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module. If no knowledge graph exists yet, it first tells you to run /understand.

say_en.note: Explains the file's role and data flow

say_en.text: Explain the function src/auth/login.ts:verifyToken in depth

say_en.note: Lists components that depend on it
